newsitem.title: CANADA: Great Lakes restructuring wins TSE approval.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes restructuring wins TSE approval.

text.p: Great Lakes Minerals Inc said on Wednesday that the Toronto Stock Exchange has granted the company conditional approval for a corporate restructuring.

Great Lakes said it wants to sell its Mexican assets to its wholly owned subsidiary, Newmex Mining Co Ltd. Newmex would pay C$14.35 million and 999,999 Newmex shares for 100 percent of Great Lakes' Lluvia de Oro gold project and the Palmarito silver and gold project.
Great Lakes said it plans to disctribute as a dividend one million Newmex shares to its shareholders of record as of February 10.

The restructuring also involves the completion of a rights offering in which Newmex will offer to the holders of the dividend Newmex shares rights to buy; 8.25 million more Newmex shares for C$2 each.
The plan was approved by shareholders on January 29, Great Lakes said.
The Toronto Stock Exchange approval is conditional upon Newmex completing the rights offering and meeting the public distribution requirements of the exchange within 90 days.
